en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a long stable building with arched windows and brick detailing. In front of the building, a line of soldiers or military personnel are tending to several horses—brushing them and checking their hooves—under the supervision of uniformed officers. The scene appears to be part of a military horse‑care routine. Red printed German text is at the top of the postcard, identifying the location and unit.
